IVM-cache-invalidation seam via ChangeBroadcast (engine/src/change.rs:113-264) registers as graph subscriber; sync layer does not reach into IVM kernel. Wire-format-bearing IVM types (TypedOutputProjection + KernelOutput in subgraph_spec.rs:92,308) carry #[non_exhaustive] per V1-FROZEN-INTERFACE.md item 11 + R2 wire-bytes-load-bearing closure. (O2) D-17 broader-enumeration cascade narrative is THOROUGH — every Version DAG container type (Anchor, DagVersionChain, VersionDag, Subgraph, SubgraphBuilder, NodeHandle), every IVM view-instance + kernel-internal surface (Subscriber, CanonicalViewEntry, AlgorithmBView, Projection, EffectiveRules + 5 view-instance structs), every materializer struct (RenderError, MaterializerError, MaterializerDenialFrame, MaterializerWalkInputs, MaterializerOutput, SubscribeAttachToken), every §4.6 vocab enum (VocabLabel, VocabEdge, Scalar) is explicitly named in Row D-17 with the deferred-to-G-COMP-1 destination + per-row anchor; the v1-beta posture (type-shape locked, attribute deferred) is the right placement per the freeze contract.
